mustFix.title: The remasurement closes OBL-G23-FX-AUTHORING against a narrower basis than the obligation's live scope and silently drops the per-D-002-platform fixture-authoring remainder
mustFix.claimUnderReview: v6 measures OBL-G23-FX-AUTHORING leftoverDesign false because g23-fixture-corpus.v3 (D-237; dual ACCEPT 0/0) 'authors implementations of all four g23-input-corpus.v1 initial states', sets namedCorpusNotAuthored to [], and publishes summary.leftoverDesign as [].
primaryEvidence: harness.DR-G23.provider-well-formed-admission.preview.v2 (D-223; the current occupancy remasurement of this very gate, which the subject itself pins at f48ba637 and calls current) states in every one of its three retained-evidence members' exactByteIntent: 'Once authored: per D-002 platform, a digest-pinned ... record'. The authored basis is platform-indexed for EV-1, EV-2, and EV-3 alike.

The same occupancy v2 passProperty states: 'Once independently pinned TypeScript-provider fixture implementations exist for NT-3 and NT-5 on every D-002 platform, each retained-evidence member's passProperty holds. Until those bytes exist, this harness cannot be executed and cannot be QUALIFIED.' Bytes that must exist before execution are pre-execution authored bytes, not qualification outputs.

Occupancy v2 proposedLaterWork attaches the platform axis to the authoring verb: 'A later D-000 cycle may author and independently pin TypeScript-provider fixture implementations for NT-3 and NT-5 and the three live-cell members, on the four D-002 platforms. This v2 occupancy does not invent those bytes.'

g23-fixture-corpus.v3 - the pinned D-237 authoring record on which this closure rests - lists 'per-platform copies of these bytes' in whatIsNotAuthored, in the same list as 'a finding schema', 'a D9 code', and 'a section 7.1 recipe', i.e. among design items it did not author. Its executionRemains sentence names only 'Host-refusal observation and subsequent-session view' as G23 execution. Per-platform copies are classified as execution nowhere in corpus v3, in D-237, or in occupancy v2.

corpus v3 authoredCatalog carries exactly four members, one per input state, with no platform index, and corpus v3 keeps leftoverDesignRemainingOnG23 as [OBL-G23-FX-AUTHORING] with remainderAfterThisCorpus deferring measurement to a later leftover-join. The subject is that later join and is therefore the artifact that must measure the whole obligation, not one axis of it.

The token 'platform' does not occur anywhere in the subject (0 occurrences in 18993 bytes). The per-platform authoring item appears in neither OBL-G23-FX-AUTHORING nor OBL-G23-EXECUTION, whose reason names only host-refusal observation and subsequent-session view. It is dropped from the partition entirely rather than reassigned.

D-056 Decision clause 5 makes authoring fixtures design work and execution qualification. D-056 Eligibility clause 2 states that authoring of fixtures is not a remainder the amendment may split, so an unauthored per-platform fixture set cannot be carried as an execution-only remainder.
mustFix.relationToLandedFindings: G23LJ-V5-M1's requiredRemedy has two halves: stop counting host-refusal and subsequent-session observations as design authoring, and 'if some additional design artifact truly remains, identify that artifact from an authoritative source and distinguish it from the execution-only observation and subsequent-session evidence.' v6 performs the first half correctly and omits the second. The per-D-002-platform pinned implementations are exactly that additional design artifact, identified from occupancy v2 (D-223 dual ACCEPT 0/0) and from corpus v3's own whatIsNotAuthored. Landing the negative half of M1 while skipping its positive half over-corrects v5's error into the opposite error.
mustFix.impact: summary.leftoverDesign [] publishes G23 as design-complete. That partition is the input a later D-056 condition-2/3 SATISFIED-GRADE cycle reads to decide whether every remaining acceptance-evidence member is execution only. Declaring [] while a named, authoritative, unauthored per-platform authoring remainder stands would let that later cycle treat an authoring remainder as an execution-only remainder, which D-056 clause 2 forbids, and would also make the subject's own leftoverDesignOpenStanding sentence ('leftover-design of OBL-G23-FX-AUTHORING is therefore stale as an authoring claim') false against the live specification of the gate it measures. Correcting the partition does not SATISFY DR-133, open Class A, execute G23, invent bytes, or authorize implementation; those boundaries stay separate.
mustFix.requiredRemedy: Either (i) retain OBL-G23-FX-AUTHORING leftoverDesign true, scoped narrowly and explicitly to the per-D-002-platform pinned implementations that corpus v3 expressly did not author, while holding host-refusal observation and subsequent-session view at OBL-G23-EXECUTION as qualification per the landed G23LJ-V5-M1; or (ii) if the platform axis is genuinely discharged by the four platform-independent payloads, say so from an authoritative source and reconcile that statement with occupancy v2's 'on every D-002 platform' passProperty, its 'per D-002 platform' exactByteIntent in EV-1/EV-2/EV-3, and corpus v3's whatIsNotAuthored entry 'per-platform copies of these bytes'. Do not close the obligation without addressing the axis. Preserve DR-133 OPEN, Class A unopened, G23 unexecuted, required-now 28, and no implementation authorization.

shouldFix.title: basedOn.predecessorV5.role misdescribes the frozen v5 review standing as a Dual REJECT when v5 was a split verdict
shouldFix.evidence: The role sentence reads 'Predecessor. Unmoved. Dual REJECT: Codex G23LJ-V5-M1 / G23LJ-V5-S1. Claude ACCEPT 0/0.' The adjacent basedOn.predecessorV5.reviews block in the same subject records claude verdict 'ACCEPT 0/0' and codex verdict 'REJECT 1 MUST-FIX G23LJ-V5-M1, 1 SHOULD-FIX G23LJ-V5-S1'. Both reproduce from live bytes: the v5 Claude 2 verdict file carries verdict ACCEPT with mustFix 0 and shouldFix 0, and the v5 Codex verdict file carries verdict REJECT with blockerCount 1, mustFixCount 1, shouldFixCount 1. One ACCEPT and one REJECT is a split, not a dual REJECT. This artifact family uses the term precisely: g23-fixture-corpus.v3 basedOn.predecessorV2.role says 'Dual REJECT' where both reviewers did reject, and this same subject's basedOn.predecessorV2.role says 'Claude REJECT CLAUDE-G23LJ-V2-SF1' rather than 'Dual REJECT' for a single-reviewer REJECT.
shouldFix.impact: The role sentence contradicts the reviews block it sits on, in a document whose declared job includes accurate custody of frozen predecessors. A later recording that reads role text alone would pin a false predecessor review standing for v5 and would misstate the Claude 2 v5 verdict.
shouldFix.requiredRemedy: Rewrite basedOn.predecessorV5.role to state the split: Codex REJECT (G23LJ-V5-M1 / G23LJ-V5-S1), Claude 2 ACCEPT 0/0. Keep v5 frozen, keep it out of the version-number lineage, and do not restate it as a dual REJECT.
